dialog.title: Configure Workflow
dialog.description: Set up an automated message for <bold>“{{audienceName}}”</bold>. For more complex flows (delays, conditions, multiple steps), use the full workflow builder.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.description: Sent immediately when a lead submits the form.

followup.title: Follow-up
followup.description: Sent N days after a lead submits the form.

followupDays.label: Send follow-up how many days after submission?
followupDays.helper: Workflow runs daily at 9:00 AM IST and messages leads whose submission date is exactly this many days ago. To send on multiple days (e.g. day 3 AND day 7) create separate workflows for each.

name.label: Workflow name
name.placeholder: e.g. Welcome confirmation for new leads

channel.label: Send via
channel.helper: Reach leads over email, WhatsApp, or both.

template.label: Email template
template.noneFound: No email templates found. Create one in the Communications section first.

whatsappTemplate.label: WhatsApp template
whatsappTemplate.noneFound: No approved WhatsApp templates found. They sync from Meta — open Communication → WhatsApp Templates and sync, or get the template approved in Meta first.
whatsappTemplate.helper: Its variables auto-fill from each lead's fields.

confirmation.descriptionFallback: Send a confirmation message when a lead submits "{{audienceName}}"

followup.descriptionFallback_one: Send a follow-up message to leads who submitted "{{audienceName}}" exactly {{count}} day ago
followup.descriptionFallback_other: Send a follow-up message to leads who submitted "{{audienceName}}" exactly {{count}} days ago
